facts.content: Sudden left-sided headache starting this morning approximately four hours ago.

facts.content: Patient has a history of kidney stones.
There is a family history of hypothyroidism.
Patient took paracetamol approximately 3 hours ago without relief.
Patient reports no known drug allergies.

facts.content: Probable acute migraine with visual aura due to unilateral left headache with visual disturbance, nausea, vomiting, movement sensitivity; it is the first episode with no focal neurological symptoms reported.
facts.source_text: Probable acute migraine with visual aura — unilateral L HA with visual disturbance, N/V, movement sensitivity; first episode; no focal neuro sx reported.

facts.content: Start ibuprofen and antiemetic over-the-counter from pharmacy.
Consume a sugary carbonated drink, such as Coke.
Arrange a same-day in-person review for a full neurological exam.

facts.content: If significantly improved before the appointment, the patient should call and cancel.
